contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row (Mark Weldon, 2,000.00) is the whole side and equals the sheet's printed page subtotal AND the promoted per-period cell Box B. ⚠ SCOPE DIVERGENCE INSIDE ONE PRINTED LINE: the sheet's second footer, 'Total Contributions Received — Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report', is filled with 75,650.88, which is NOT the sum of this report's Schedule A pages (2,000.00) but the CUMULATIVE figure the summary page carries in Box C. The filer used the sum-of-pages slot for his cycle-to-date total. The reconciliation therefore gates on the figures matching the side's own scope — the page subtotal and Box B — and 75,650.88 is recorded as the cumulative it is and never summed as an increment.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = $5870.00 on the p4 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page 5870.00'
expenditures.detail: 2 Schedule B rows sum to 2500.00 + 3370.00 = 5,870.00 exactly = the printed page subtotal = Box D. The same scope divergence appears here: Schedule B's 'Total Expenditures Made — Sum of all Schedule B Pages in this report' is filled with $73,624.77, the cumulative figure that also stands in Box E, not the 5,870.00 this report's pages sum to. Box E is never summed as an increment. The summary ladder closes exactly: A 5,896.11 + B 2,000.00 = 7,896.11 = F, and F - D = 2,026.11 = G.

Sakievich' — printed in the cover's Name of Candidate box, on the affirmation line, and in the Name of Candidate footer of all three following pages; index.csv's channel label is 'Thomas Sakievich' (no middle initial). The page face governs. PAGE-FACE OFFICE: 'Utah County Commissioner' — NO SEAT LETTER IS PRINTED ANYWHERE, and none was inferred; index.csv's office is the seat-less 'County Commission', which agrees. FORM: modern_boxAF on the NEWER UNVERSIONED 2022 blank (In-Kind checkbox column, Schedule B with a Purpose column, close box lettered G, six report types, 'Date of Filing' field), filled as a born-digital typed fillable PDF (pdfinfo reports Form: AcroForm) then printed, signed and re-scanned. FOUR PAGES, each classified from its own printed heading: p1 cover (End-of-Year Report selected by a filled radio dot; amendment answered 'No'; dated and filed December 21, 2022), p2 SCHEDULE A, p3 SCHEDULE B, p4 SUMMARY PAGE (A $5896.11 / B $2000.00 / C $75,650.88 / D $5870.00 / E $73,624.77 / F $7896.11 / G $2026.11). NO Elections-Division CHECKLIST is bound. ⚠ A FILER CORRECTION TO THE FORM'S OWN PRINTED LABELS: on the summary page the printed words 'Year to Date' are STRUCK THROUGH in BOTH the Box C header ('Contributions Received ~~Year to Date~~') and the Box E header ('Expenditures Made ~~Year to Date~~'), leaving the box captions reading simply 'Contributions Received' / 'Expenditures Made'. The figures in those boxes (75,650.88 / 73,624.77) are far larger than a single calendar year of this filing's own activity and match the cumulative totals the filer also typed into both schedules' 'Sum of all Schedule Pages' footers, so the strike-through appears to mean 'cycle to date, not year to date'. That is RECORDED AS OBSERVED and NOT ADJUDICATED — the module's promotion regime already treats C and E as the cumulative column and never sums them as increments. ⚠ THE SECOND SCHEDULE FOOTER CARRIES A DIFFERENT SCOPE FROM ITS PRINTED LABEL on BOTH schedules: 'Total Contributions Received — Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report' holds 75,650.88 against a page subtotal of 2,000.00, and 'Total Expenditures Made — Sum of all Schedule B Pages in this report' holds 73,624.77 against a page subtotal of 5,870.00. Each side was therefore reconciled against the figures matching ITS OWN SCOPE (the page subtotal and Box B / Box D), both of which close exactly; no cumulative figure was used as a gate and no two figures were differenced. REDACTION: this IS a *_Redacted file and the bars are on the page — the county blacked out the whole Address/City/State/Zip block and the entire Signature box on the cover. Nothing else on the filing is obscured; the two donor/vendor address-bearing fields that exist (Schedule A's City and State) are in the clear. Both expenditures are loan repayments to the candidate and his spouse, and both are dated in 2020 and 2021, outside this End-of-Year 2022 report's period — flagged on the rows, not adjudicated. Only one donor is itemized in the period.
